text.arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ لَآ أُقْسِمُ بِيَوْمِ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ

translations.asad: NAY! I call to witness the Day of Resurrection!
translations.sahih: I swear by the Day of Resurrection

translations.asad: But nay! I call to witness the accusing voice of man's own conscience!
translations.sahih: And I swear by the reproaching soul [to the certainty of resurrection].

translations.asad: Does man think that We cannot [resurrect him and] bring his bones together again?
translations.sahih: Does man think that We will not assemble his bones?

text.arabic: بَلَىٰ قَٰدِرِينَ عَلَىٰٓ أَن نُّسَوِّىَ بَنَانَهُۥ

translations.asad: Yea indeed, We are able to make whole his very finger-tips!
translations.sahih: Yes. [We are] Able [even] to proportion his fingertips.

translations.asad: None the less man chooses to deny what lies ahead of him,
translations.sahih: But man desires to continue in sin.

translations.asad: asking [derisively], "When is that Resurrection Day to be?"
translations.sahih: He asks, "When is the Day of Resurrection?"

translations.asad: But [on that Day,] when the eyesight is by fear confounded,
translations.sahih: So when vision is dazzled

translations.asad: and the moon is darkened,
translations.sahih: And the moon darkens

translations.asad: and the sun and the moon are brought together
translations.sahih: And the sun and the moon are joined,

translations.asad: on that Day will man exclaim "Whither to flee?"
translations.sahih: Man will say on that Day, "Where is the [place of] escape?"

translations.asad: But nay: no refuge [for thee, O man]!
translations.sahih: No! There is no refuge.

translations.asad: With thy Sustainer, on that Day, the journey's end will be!
translations.sahih: To your Lord, that Day, is the [place of] permanence.

text.arabic: يُنَبَّؤُا۟ ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ يَوْمَئِذٍۭ بِمَا قَدَّمَ وَأَخَّرَ

translations.asad: Man will be apprised, on that Day, of what he has done and what he has left undone:
translations.sahih: Man will be informed that Day of what he sent ahead and kept back.

translations.asad: nay, but man shall against himself be an eye-witness,
translations.sahih: Rather, man, against himself, will be a witness,

translations.asad: even though he may veil himself in excuses.
translations.sahih: Even if he presents his excuses.

text.arabic: لَا تُحَرِّكْ بِهِۦ لِسَانَكَ لِتَعْجَلَ بِهِۦٓ

translations.asad: MOVE NOT thy tongue in haste, [repeating the words of the revelation:]
translations.sahih: Move not your tongue with it, [O Muhammad], to hasten with recitation of the Qur'an.

translations.asad: for, behold, it is for Us to gather it [in thy heart,] and to cause it to be read [as it ought to be read].
translations.sahih: Indeed, upon Us is its collection [in your heart] and [to make possible] its recitation.

translations.asad: Thus, when We recite it, follow thou its wording [with all thy mind]:
translations.sahih: So when We have recited it [through Gabriel], then follow its recitation.

translations.asad: and then, behold, it will be for Us to make its meaning clear.
translations.sahih: Then upon Us is its clarification [to you].

translations.asad: NAY, but [most of] you love this fleeting life,
translations.sahih: No! But you love the immediate

translations.asad: and give no thought to the life to come [and to Judgment Day]!
translations.sahih: And leave the Hereafter.

translations.asad: Some faces will on that Day be bright with happiness,
translations.sahih: [Some] faces, that Day, will be radiant,

translations.asad: looking up to their Sustainer;
translations.sahih: Looking at their Lord.

translations.asad: and some faces will on that Day be overcast with despair,
translations.sahih: And [some] faces, that Day, will be contorted,

translations.asad: knowing that a crushing calamity is about to befall them.
translations.sahih: Expecting that there will be done to them [something] backbreaking.

translations.asad: NAY, but when [the last breath] comes up to the throat [of a dying man],
translations.sahih: No! When the soul has reached the collar bones

translations.asad: and people ask, "Is there any wizard [that could save him]?"
translations.sahih: And it is said, "Who will cure [him]?"

translations.asad: the while he [himself] knows that this is the parting,
translations.sahih: And the dying one is certain that it is the [time of] separation

translations.asad: and is enwrapped in the pangs of death
translations.sahih: And the leg is wound about the leg,

translations.asad: at that time towards thy Sustainer does he feel impelled to turn!
translations.sahih: To your Lord, that Day, will be the procession.

translations.asad: [Useless, though, will be his repentance: for [as long as he was alive] he did not accept the truth, nor did he pray [for enlightenment],
translations.sahih: And the disbeliever had not believed, nor had he prayed.

translations.asad: but, on the contrary, he gave the lie to the truth and turned away [from it],
translations.sahih: But [instead], he denied and turned away.

translations.asad: and then went arrogantly back to what he had come from.
translations.sahih: And then he went to his people, swaggering [in pride].

translations.asad: [And yet, O man, thine end comes hourly] nearer unto thee, and nearer –
translations.sahih: Woe to you, and woe!

translations.asad: and ever nearer unto thee, and nearer!
translations.sahih: Then woe to you, and woe!

translations.asad: DOES MAN, then, think that he is to be left to himself to go about at will?
translations.sahih: Does man think that he will be left neglected?

text.arabic: أَلَمْ يَكُ نُطْفَةًۭ مِّن مَّنِىٍّۢ يُمْنَىٰ

translations.asad: Was he not once a [mere] drop of sperm that had been spilt,
translations.sahih: Had he not been a sperm from semen emitted?

translations.asad: and thereafter became a germ-cell - whereupon He created and formed [it] in accordance with what [it] was meant to be,
translations.sahih: Then he was a clinging clot, and [Allah] created [his form] and proportioned [him]

translations.asad: and fashioned out of it the two sexes, the male and the female?
translations.sahih: And made of him two mates, the male and the female.

text.arabic: أَلَيْسَ ذَٰلِكَ بِقَٰدِرٍ عَلَىٰٓ أَن يُحْۦِىَ ٱلْمَوْتَىٰ

translations.asad: Is not He, then; able to bring the dead back to life?
translations.sahih: Is not that [Creator] Able to give life to the dead?
